english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for angrily scolding someone.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for angrily scolding or sharply criticising someone.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for attacking someone with abusive language.
Use this for a sharp or angry rebuke, especially when someone is being scolded.
Use this when the sharp speech is directed at someone as a scolding.
Use this when someone is being vigorously scolded rather than mocked.

examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 naau6 ngo5 laa3

examples.english: They rebuke me in front of everyone for being late.
examples.traditional: 佢因為我遲到，當住成班人鬧我。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 dong1 zyu6 sing4 baan1 jan4 naau6 ngo5

examples.english: They revile people behind their backs all the time.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 naau6 jan4

examples.english: My mum will reproach me whenever I get home late.
examples.traditional: 我一夜返屋企，阿媽就會鬧我。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 je6 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3 maa1 zau6 wui5 naau6 ngo5

examples.english: My boss tends to snap at me when I’m late.
